mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY (SRVY_QITEM, CO_SN, COHORT_SN, SRVY_BGNG_DT, SRVY_END_DT, USER_SN) VALUES (#{srvyQitem}, #{coSn}, #{cohortSn}, #{srvyBgngDt}, #{srvyEndDt}, #{userSn})
mapper.select: SELECT S.SRVY_SN, S.SRVY_QITEM, S.CO_SN, S.COHORT_SN, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT, S.SRVY_END_DT, U.USER_NM FROM TB_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.SRVY_SN = #{srvySn}
SELECT S.SRVY_SN, S.SRVY_QITEM, S.CO_SN, S.COHORT_SN, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT, S.SRVY_END_DT, U.USER_NM FROM TB_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.CO_SN = #{coSn}
